name: Enterprise
tagLine: Unified biometric access control for complex, multi-site organisations.
body:
## Securing the modern enterprise

Large organisations face a unique set of access control challenges: dozens of buildings, thousands of employees, multiple security zones and the constant pressure to reduce administrative overhead. Suprema's enterprise solutions bring all of this under a single, unified platform — BioStar 2 — accessible from any web browser without additional client software.

## What Suprema delivers for enterprise

- **Centralised management** across unlimited doors, floors and buildings from a single dashboard
- **Role-based access control (RBAC)** with time-scheduling, allowing fine-grained control over who can access what and when
- **Multi-factor authentication** — fingerprint, face, card and mobile credentials in any combination to match your security policy
- **Audit trails and compliance reporting** — every access event is logged, timestamped and exportable for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and internal audits
- **Visitor management** — built-in visitor registration, self-service kiosks and temporary credential issuance
- **Active Directory / LDAP integration** — employee records sync automatically, eliminating duplicate data entry

## Scalability without compromise

BioStar 2 scales from a single door to a global network of 1 000+ doors without a change in architecture. South African enterprises benefit from local installation options or Azure-hosted deployments in South Africa North for data residency compliance.

caseStudies.title: Financial services campus — Johannesburg
caseStudies.summary: Deployed 240 XStation 2 terminals across a new 12-storey head office campus, replacing legacy proximity card readers. Authentication time reduced from 3.2 s to 0.8 s; tailgating incidents down 94% in the first 90 days.
